svg.desc: El Sawaleh Fakos LOCATION Sharkeya Governorate, Egypt CLIENT Sharkia Water and Wastewater Company STATUS EST. VALUE In Progress 280 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview This project upgrades and rehabilitates sewage networks in the Fakous and El Sawaleh cluster, including El Hegagia, Sawada and El Rawda. BECT provides architectural, structural and civil engineering, MEP, project management and site supervision services for Sharkia Water and Wastewater Company.
